items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They called him Bunker, I believe. [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Oh, I knew Manzi. Manzi came from Bill Cassancho. Oh, is that right? That's where he was. He and his brother. He had a brother that played there.
They called him Bunker, I believe.
